The worked example of PARTS_INTELLIGENCE.md:74-79 prices one card on its own, inside a PC and in a bundle. The index keeps the three contexts apart (the card: bundle asks are kept apart from PC asks), and `v_implied` gives the PC median minus the standalone median (125000 - 60000 = 65000) as an internal sensitivity; the two IQRs are never added (PARTS_INTELLIGENCE.md:119-120). The actor repository is not in this session, so the asks are synthetic; the case checks the grouping, not the brief's figures (docs/questions/asking-price-index.md).
